_brief: Item 12, Phone Call Video / Tel Aviv. Compilation 2 (light), seven people. V2 after Tal's note on V1 (2026-10-03): 'you don't see the what makes you happy thing. You should get them picking up the phone.' It now OPENS on the sign standing in the street, readable, and a woman walking up and picking up the red phone ('People I love.'), and every person is framed wide enough that the sign and the phone are in shot (static 1.0-1.6x, were 1.0-2.2x); captions sit above the sign. The woman from the opening comes back at the end to finish her answer ('my family, my dog, my co-workers'). NO ZOOMS.

_notes: Same cast as V1. Order: opening woman, bagel, 'be kind' (strongest, 3rd), Shabbat, cold beer, Jewish side, to fly, opening woman again. Four women and three men, so one woman-woman join is unavoidable; it is the last one (the 'to fly' woman into the returning opener). The teenager's 'I love to eat' stays out (minor).
